data.name: Home.Description
data.value: Manage configuration drafts and releases by project, environment, and key. The SDK reads only published snapshots for stable production integration.

data.name: ProjectCreate.Description
data.value: A project is the boundary for configuration management and SDK reads. After creating it, add environments, configuration keys, and releases.

data.name: ProjectCreate.GuideEnvironmentDescription
data.value: Maintain independent draft values for dev, test, prod, and other environments. Releases create stable environment snapshots.

data.name: ProjectCreate.GuideProjectDescription
data.value: The project key becomes the core boundary for SDK reads and access key management, so keep it stable.

data.name: ProjectCreate.GuideReleaseDescription
data.value: Draft changes never affect clients directly. The SDK reads only published versions.

data.name: ProjectCreate.KeyHelp
data.value: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, for example order-service.

data.name: ProjectCreate.ValidationRequired
data.value: Enter both project name and project key.

data.name: ProjectDetail.NoConfigurations
data.value: No configuration keys yet. Next, add a configuration group and key.

data.name: ProjectDetail.NoEnvironments
data.value: No environments yet. Next, add dev, test, or prod environments.

data.name: ProjectDetail.NotFoundDescription
data.value: The project does not exist. It may have been deleted or the link is invalid.

data.name: Projects.Description
data.value: Organize environments, configuration definitions, draft values, and release versions by project. Clients read published snapshots by project key and environment key.

data.name: Projects.EmptyDescription
data.value: After creating the first project, you can add environments, configuration keys, and publish snapshots for SDK clients.

data.name: EnvironmentCreate.Description
data.value: Environments isolate dev, test, prod, and other configuration drafts and release snapshots. SDK clients read by environment key.

data.name: EnvironmentCreate.GuideIsolationDescription
data.value: Each environment owns independent draft values, so testing edits never affect production values.

data.name: EnvironmentCreate.GuideReleaseDescription
data.value: Release scope is fixed to project plus environment. The SDK reads only the latest release for that environment.

data.name: EnvironmentCreate.KeyHelp
data.value: Use stable lowercase identifiers such as dev, test, or prod.

data.name: EnvironmentCreate.ValidationRequired
data.value: Enter both environment name and environment key.

data.name: ConfigurationCreate.Description
data.value: A configuration definition combines a group and key and is unique inside the project. Each environment stores its own draft value.

data.name: ConfigurationCreate.GroupHelp
data.value: For example Database, FeatureFlags, or Logging.

data.name: ConfigurationCreate.GuideKeyDescription
data.value: The SDK outputs keys as Group:Key so they plug directly into .NET IConfiguration.

data.name: ConfigurationCreate.GuideSensitiveDescription
data.value: Sensitive draft values are encrypted at rest and masked on management detail pages.

data.name: ConfigurationCreate.IsSensitiveHelp
data.value: Use this for connection strings, tokens, secrets, and values that must not be shown in plain text.

data.name: ConfigurationCreate.KeyHelp
data.value: For example ConnectionString, Enabled, or MinimumLevel.

data.name: ConfigurationCreate.ValidationRequired
data.value: Enter both configuration group and configuration key.

data.name: AccessKey.Description
data.value: The project Access Key lets SDK clients read published configuration snapshots. Rotating it immediately invalidates the previous key.

data.name: AccessKey.GeneratedHelp
data.value: Copy it now. This plaintext value cannot be viewed again after leaving the page.

data.name: AccessKey.Warning
data.value: Security note: the system stores only the key hash. The new key is shown once after rotation; do not put it in logs, screenshots, or public repositories.

data.name: PublishEnvironment.Description
data.value: Publishing creates an immutable snapshot from the current environment drafts. The SDK reads only the latest published version.

data.name: PublishEnvironment.NoConfigurations
data.value: This project has no configuration definitions, so it cannot be published.

data.name: PublishEnvironment.NoLatestRelease
data.value: This environment has no releases yet. This publish will create the first snapshot.

data.name: PublishEnvironment.NoteHelp
data.value: Describe this release for audit and rollback context.

data.name: PublishEnvironment.NotFoundDescription
data.value: The project or environment does not exist, so configuration cannot be published.

data.name: ReleaseHistory.Description
data.value: Release history contains immutable snapshots. Rolling back creates a new release from the selected historical version and notifies SDK clients to refresh.

data.name: ReleaseHistory.NoReleases
data.value: This environment has no releases yet.

data.name: ReleaseHistory.NotFoundDescription
data.value: The project or environment does not exist, so release history cannot be viewed.
